# Qalvin UI

> A modern, accessible component library built with Base UI primitives, React 19, and Tailwind CSS v4.

Qalvin UI provides 40+ accessible UI components, interactive blocks, creative WebGL shaders, and high-level design pattern skills. All components adhere to WAI-ARIA standards and are fully customizable with Tailwind CSS v4 and OKLCH color palettes.

## CLI & Installation

- Initialize project: `pnpm dlx @alvinahmad/ui init`
- Add component: `pnpm dlx @alvinahmad/ui add [component-name]`
- Add skill: `pnpm dlx @alvinahmad/ui skills add [skill-name]`
- Start MCP server: `pnpm dlx @alvinahmad/ui mcp`

## Core Components

- [Button](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/components/button): Interactive button with variants (default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, link).
- [Accordion](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/components/accordion): Vertically stacked interactive panels with smooth collapse transitions.
- [Autocomplete](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/components/autocomplete): High-performance combobox and search input with fuzzy filtering and async data loading.
- [Checkbox Group](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/components/checkbox-group): Grouped checkboxes with shared array state and form validation.
- [Composer](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/components/composer): Rich AI chat and content composer with prompt input, actions bar, and attachments.
- [Dialog](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/components/dialog): Accessible modal dialog overlaid on primary content with backdrop blur.
- [Fieldset](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/components/fieldset): Form grouping primitive with accessible legend heading.
- [Frame](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/components/frame): Structural layout frame container for dashboards, canvas previews, and panels.
- [Group](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/components/group): Visual container for joining buttons, inputs, and controls seamlessly.
- [Menu](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/components/menu): Dropdown menus with sub-menus, checkboxes, radio items, and keyboard navigation.
- [Meter](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/components/meter): Graphical display of a numeric value within a defined range (e.g., storage, capacity).
- [Number Field](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/components/number-field): Stepped numeric input with increment and decrement control buttons.
- [OTP Field](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/components/otp-field): One-time password verification input with auto-advance and separators.
- [Preview Card](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/components/preview-card): Popover card preview triggered on hover with portal positioning.
- [Segmented Control](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/components/segmented-control): Mutually exclusive segmented button pill selector.

## Creative UI & Shaders

- [Thinking Orb](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/thinking-orb): Interactive 3D WebGL particle sphere for AI reasoning visualization.
- [Metal FX](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/metal-fx): Specular liquid metal shader reflections with responsive cursor tracking.
- [Voice Glow](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/voice-glow): Voice-reactive glowing audio beam driven by microphone input or audio envelope.
- [Liquid Gooey](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/liquid-gooey): Fluid SVG filter metaball morphing effects for dynamic interfaces.
- [Sticky Slides](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/sticky-slides): Full-page stacked scroll presentation decks in TSX, JSX, TS, and JS formats.
- [Border Beam](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/border-beam): Animated glowing border gradient beam along container edges.
- [Dot Field](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/dot-field): Interactive dot field background with magnetic particle repulsion.
- [Background Paths](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/background-paths): Floating radiant SVG bezier light path streams.
- [Flow Field](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/flow-field): Streamline curl-noise vector fields that scatter on click.
- [Card Flip](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/card-flip): 3D perspective card flip with front and back interactive faces.
- [Card Stack](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/card-stack): Swipeable stacked deck of cards with smooth gesture physics.
- [Liquid Glass Card](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/liquid-glass-card): Glassmorphism music player card with spinning, scrubbable disc.
- [Apple Activity Card](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/apple-activity-card): Concentric fitness rings with metric breakdown.
- [Bento Grid](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/bento-grid): Asymmetric responsive bento grid showcase layout.
- [Morphic Navbar](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/morphic-navbar): Floating morphing navigation bar with elastic indicator.
- [Toolbar](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/toolbar): macOS-style dock toolbar with fluid tooltips.
- [Cart Button](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/cart-button): Interactive e-commerce add-to-cart button that expands into a stepper.
- [AI Prompt](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/ai-prompt): Multi-action generative AI prompt composer with autosizing textarea.
- [AI Input Search](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/ai-input-search): Smart AI search input with suggestion chips.
- [AI Tool Approval](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/ai-tool-approval): Interactive confirmation card for AI function execution.
- [AI Diff Review](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/ai-diff-review): Side-by-side git diff review card for AI code generation.
- [Particle Button](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/particle-button): Confetti particle explosion trigger on click.
- [Hold Button](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/ui/hold-button): Long-press radial progress button for critical actions.

## React Hooks

- [useMediaQuery](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-media-query): SSR-safe reactive CSS media query watcher.
- [useCopyToClipboard](https://qalvinui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-copy-to-clipboard): Clipboard copy helper with status feedback and fallback.
